title: Python 3.8 is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches
summary: Python 3.8 reached end of life on 7 October 2024. Applications still pinned to python:3.8, runtime.txt, or requires-python 3.8 are running an unsupported runtime. A Python source edit cannot patch the interpreter.
remediation: Upgrade the Python image, requires-python / runtime.txt / .python-version, and CI python-version to a currently supported release (3.12 for this demo). Keep application source unchanged unless a compatibility check fails.
